CA.rationale: Content (red positions) and a processing/origin condition are bound for the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red positions), an organization-style pattern for that content, and a distinct origin/status field are all explicit for the same candidate referent/time.

A.rationale: Origin/processing metadata (executed_branch_claim, native_conditional_record) links a processing condition to the candidate content's representation.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content items (red coordinates) with attribute labels.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status field (executed_branch_claim, kind) is presented separately from the content coordinates.

O.rationale: The text states layout conventions and shows explicit spatial groupings/patterns for the identified contents.
